name: codes-doctor-monorepo
description: Codes Doctor: analysis engine, CLI and VS Code extension

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix packages/engine && npm ci --prefix packages/cli && npm ci --prefix packages/vscode
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/engine && npm run build --prefix packages/cli && npm run build --prefix packages/vscode
scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/engine && npm test --prefix packages/cli && npm test --prefix packages/vscode
scripts.package:vsix: npm run install:all && npm run package:release --prefix packages/vscode
scripts.verify:deps: node scripts/verify-install.mjs packages/engine packages/cli packages/vscode && node scripts/check-supply-chain.mjs && npm run audit
